elements.text: There are many reasons people do not receive help. Why are you not receiving mental health treatment? Please select all that apply.

buttons: I don't think a prescription medication would help me
I don't like the idea of taking prescription medication
I can't afford to pay for treatment
I don't want to talk to a mental health professional (e.g., a therapist)
I don't think that a mental health professional can help me
It is hard to find a mental health professional near me
I don't know how to find a mental health professional
I am embarrassed to seek treatment
I don't want to be asked to face my fears (e.g., not wanting to interact with a spider for a person with spider fear)
I don't want to talk about my feelings
I had treatment previously and didn't find it helpful
I don't need help at this time
